title: BayesFlow 2: Multi-Backend Amortized Bayesian Inference in Python
abstract: arXiv:2602.07098v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern Bayesian inference involves a mixture of computational methods for estimating, validating, and drawing conclusions from probabilistic models as part of principled workflows. An overarching motif of many Bayesian methods is that they are relatively slow, which often becomes prohibitive when fitting complex models to large data sets. Amortized Bayesian inference (ABI) offers a path to solving the computational challenges of Bayes. ABI trains neural networks on model simulations, rewarding users with rapid inference of any model-implied quantity, such as point estimates, likelihoods, or full posterior distributions. In this work, we present the Python library BayesFlow, Version 2, for general-purpose ABI. translated_title: BayesFlow 2：Python中的多后端摊销贝叶斯推断
translated_abstract: 现代贝叶斯推断涉及多种计算方法的组合，用于在系统性工作流程中对概率模型进行估计、验证并从中得出结论。许多贝叶斯方法的一个共同特征是速度相对较慢，在将复杂模型拟合到大型数据集时，这往往成为难以逾越的障碍。摊销贝叶斯推断为解决贝叶斯方法的计算挑战提供了一条途径。ABI通过在模型模拟数据上训练神经网络，使用户能够快速推断任何模型隐含的量，例如点估计、似然或完整的后验分布。在这项工作中，我们介绍了用于通用ABI的Python库BayesFlow第2版。除了直接的后验、似然和比率估计外，该软件还支持多种流行的深度学习后端，并提供丰富的用于采样和密度估计的生成网络集合。
tldr: BayesFlow 2是一个支持多种深度学习后端的通用Python库，通过摊销贝叶斯推断实现对后验分布、似然和比率的快速估计，解决了传统贝叶斯方法在复杂模型和大数据集上的计算瓶颈。
en_tdlr: BayesFlow 2 is a general-purpose Python library for amortized Bayesian inference featuring multi-backend deep learning support, enabling rapid posterior, likelihood, and ratio estimation to overcome the computational bottlenecks of traditional Bayesian methods.
